Messages.Body:
Just changing concealed weapon to only allow cost 0 and 1 weapons would fix a lot of melee weapons problems. Another problem is immoral grapple, so far two weapons deals with it. Other than that, well, it's often not worth it to take an action to increase damage dealt in combat ... or not.

If we added in rulings for bashing and lethal damage, we would end up with even more clunky and annoying rules. Updating melee weapons, by erratta or by new cards, wont change that melee is less good than ranged weapon combat. Messages.Author: Charles_Bronson
Messages.Body:
I own four assamites decks on melee weapons. I assure you: most of them are somewhat weak, losing fights because of .44 maneuverings or immortals/drawings.

There are no advantages for melee weapons whatever in this game. I reached the conclusion the best melee weapons are those that have no cost - jouloms axe, argent baton and weighted walkin stick. And rowan ring of course. Why would someone pay 3 pool on a kali's fang? Much better go for a 4 pool flamethrower for obvious reasons.

I felt so frustrated that I even submitted a melee weapon card combat.

> www.vekn.net/forum/30-expansion-sets-a-card-ideas/50060-submission-silent-approach-and-dance-of-death
>
> Name: Silent Approach
> Cardtype: Combat
> Cost: No cost.
> Capacity: Not applicable.
> Discipline: Quietus
> Clan: none
> Maneuver, only usable to go to close range.
> As above, and/or this vampire can equip with a melee weapon from your hand (pay costs and fullfill requirements as normal).
>
Assamites and other in game disciplines like     should be awesome with melee weapons. In fact the better they can do is garrote + baal or some other cheap trick.

I am death.
Paul Kersey, Death Wish

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Melee weapons are only good in joke and gimmick decks.

I built unique melee with assamites strike at the true flesh/ fortitude for prevent. Not great.

Laibon !saulbri with agf kerries was neat, but my African Death Stick deck isnt as good as other !salubri builds ive done.

I once did "Holy Cock" where I fot true faith and crusader sword on Cock Robin. Worked as well as any cock robin deck with a bolted on joke, I suppose.

WWS is the only practical melee weapon, due to its no cost, no concealed required, and even as temporary as it is, fluidity and saving a card slot make up for it. Yes, stickmen could conceal out 44s instead, but its 5-6 cardslots, getting them drawn, and pool to save some blood when fortitude and presses do more anyway, even if the stick will always break after a few swings.
Brass knuckles 2.0, a switchblade, and an unbrella sword could be made to mimick WWS, but current options just arent good enough.
